note: Written once from the reference comments; record offsets are relative to the live copy (base); instances are the other copies (room definitions at $C000 + $100 n, n = 0-60; entity definitions at $A000 + 8 n by type). A layout "span" is the extent its fields cover when it exceeds the record size.

records.name: room_buffer
records.evidence: jsw.skool g32768-g33023 (ROOMLAYOUT..ENTITIES); room definitions b49152+256n (rooms 0-60, room 47 unused): "The next N bytes are copied to #R..." mid-block comments; routine 35090 copies 256 bytes

fields.name: room layout: 32x16 cells, 2 bits each (background, floor, wall, nasty)
tiles: background, floor, wall, nasty, ramp, conveyor (attribute + 8 rows)
address of the location in the attribute buffer at 24064
direction (0 = up to the left, 1 = up to the right)
address of the bottom of the ramp in the attribute buffer at 24064

records.name: room_exits
records.evidence: jsw.skool g33001 LEFT / RIGHT / ABOVE / BELOW

records.name: entity_specs
records.evidence: jsw.skool g33008 ENTITIES ("eight pairs of bytes"); room definitions +240 ("Terminator (#R41976)" = first byte 255)

fields.name: entity definition number (index into the definitions at 40960; 255 = terminator)
base sprite index and x-coordinate of a guardian, y-coordinate of an arrow, x-coordinate of the top of a rope

records.name: entity_buffer
records.evidence: jsw.skool g33024 ENTITYBUF tables (horizontal / vertical guardian, arrow, rope; terminator at 33088); definitions b40960+8n (128, copied by routine 35090), layout instances by entity type (bits 0-2 of the first byte)

fields.name: bit 7 direction (0 = left, 1 = right), bits 5-6 animation frame index, bits 3-4 unused, bits 0-2 entity type (001)
bits 5-7 animation frame index mask, bit 4 unused, bit 3 BRIGHT, bits 0-2 INK
bits 5-7 base sprite index, bits 0-4 x-coordinate
pixel y-coordinate x2 (index into the screen buffer address table at 33280)
page containing the sprite graphic data
bits 5-7 animation frame index, bits 3-4 animation frame update flags, bits 0-2 entity type (010)
bits 5-7 animation frame index mask, bit 4 unused, bit 3 BRIGHT, bits 0-2 INK
bits 5-7 base sprite index, bits 0-4 x-coordinate
pixel y-coordinate x2 (index into the screen buffer address table at 33280)
page containing the sprite graphic data
bit 7 direction (0 = left, 1 = right), bits 3-6 unused, bits 0-2 entity type (100)
pixel y-coordinate x2 (index into the screen buffer address table at 33280)
top/bottom pixel row (drawn either side of the shaft)

layouts.name: rope
layouts.note: the rope also uses the second and fourth bytes of the following buffer

fields.name: bit 7 direction (0 = left, 1 = right), bits 3-6 unused, bits 0-2 entity type (011)
x-coordinate of the top of the rope
x-coordinate of the segment of rope being drawn
animation frame at which the rope changes direction (54)
index of the segment of rope being drawn (0-32)
bit 0 Willy is on the rope, bits 1-7 unused

records.name: items
records.evidence: jsw.skool b41984 ITEMTABLE1 / b42240 ITEMTABLE2: item N (173-255) is the byte pair at 41984+N and 42240+N; first item index at 41983; routines 34762 and 37841

layouts.name: item
layouts.note: two parallel byte tables 256 bytes apart

fields.name: bit 7 MSB of the y-coordinate, bit 6 collection flag (reset = collected), bits 0-5 room
bits 5-7 LSBs of the y-coordinate, bits 0-4 x-coordinate

records.name: willy_state
records.evidence: jsw.skool g34255-g34261 (WILLY_Y, DMFLAGS, AIRBORNE, FRAME, LOCATION, JUMPING); copy at g34263 INITSTATE (routines 35090 and 35841)

fields.name: y-coordinate: LSB into the screen buffer address table at 33280 (pixel y x2)
direction and movement flags: bit 0 facing left, bit 1 moving
airborne status: 0 no, 1 jumping, 2-11 falling, 12-15 fallen too far, 255 collided
address of the location in the attribute buffer at 23552

records.name: writetyper
records.evidence: jsw.skool b34277 WRITETYPER: "In each pair of bytes here ..." (no keys pressed, then W-R-I-T-E-T-Y-P-E-R); routine 35591
